title: The ordinary Koszul augmentation Cech cycle is the unit cycle
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number and f:Fin(r) to A. Let C be the explicit extended tilde of A[0], M its top-sections complex, and t the tilde of the extended index-zero augmentation in [def-sc-koszul-open-system]. Let k be the Hom-object comparison inverse, stage-zero colimit injection and Koszul-to-Cech comparison in [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. In ordinary complex homology, H^0(k) applied to koszulHomChainClass(transpose(t)) equals H^0 of the Cech augmentation applied to openStructureUnitClass(A,koszulOpen(A,r,f)) in [lem-sc-derived-open-structure-sections-unit]. The statement requires no chosen derived categories and no evaluation equivalence.

source.place: Proof: signed psi^{p,q} fraction comparison; Tag 08D0 singleton formula

proof.text: Transpose the tilde of the augmentation through the ordinary tilde/sections adjunction. On a singleton basis e_j its value is f_j times the global unit: contraction in exterior degree one evaluates the linear form at e_j, the exterior-degree-zero equivalence sends the algebra scalar to that scalar, and the adjunction unit is tilde.toOpen at the top open.

The structure complex has only degree zero. In the degree-zero Hom cochain Cech image, all larger-subset components have coefficient degree 1-card(J) different from zero and vanish. On a singleton the p=q=0 sign is positive. The cocone equation says f_j times the image equals restriction of f_j times the unit; cancel using invertibility of f_j on D(f_j). The resulting cycle is exactly the ordinary Cech augmentation of restriction of one.

The unit class was constructed by the termwise tilde.toOpen map applied to the homology class of 1 in the extended single complex. Naturality of moduleCatCyclesIso and of the homology projection carries the cycle equality through the Hom-object iso and colimit injection to the displayed equality. For r=0 all Cech components disappear. If f_j=0 its open and sections module are zero; hence the cancellation argument remains valid, including the zero ring.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulOpen_augmentation_cech_unit
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) :
    let C := openStructureSheafComplex A
    let M := ((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C
    let t := ((koszulOpenTilde A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (koszulOpenAugmentation A r f 0)
        ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
    let k := (koszulCechHomObjIso A r f M 0).inv ≫
      colimit.ι (koszulCechHomDiagram A r f M) 0 ≫ koszulCechComparison A r f C
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k 0
        (koszulHomChainClass (koszulOpenHomTranspose A r f C 0 t)) =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((principalCechAugmentation r f).app C) 0
        (openStructureUnitClass A (koszulOpen A r f))
